####################################################################################################
Purpose: This script assigns vaccine concentrations per study, RCT group, and country for the 
included studies across the pathogens.

Functions Used:
- `fun_dgsk_vacconc.R`: Add vaccine concentrations that have exceptions. 

Output:
- `stu_vaccconc.rds`:  Data frame containing GSK vaccine concentrations per pathogen, study, 
RCT group, and country.
####################################################################################################

# Load packages, themes, directories, and functions
```{r}
rm(list = ls())
source("00_pck.R")
source("fun_data/fun_dgsk_vacconc.R")
```

# Load data 
```{r}
# Load the data frame of included studies per pathogen
stu_included_perpat <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$processed}/stu_included_perpat.rds")) %>% 
  filter(included == TRUE)
```

# Read in the RCT group names for each pathogen
```{r}
stu_rctg <- sapply(unique(stu_included_perpat$pat), function(i) {
  sapply(filter(stu_included_perpat, included == TRUE, pat == i)$study, function(x) {
    readRDS(glue("{dirs$processed}/01_stu_tidydfs/stu_df_pid_{x}.rds")) %>%
      mutate(rct_group = tolower(rct_group)) %>%
      distinct(study, rct_group, country)
      }, simplify = FALSE) %>%
    bind_rows()
}, simplify = FALSE)
```

# Read in the vaccine concentrations data and tidy up 
```{r}
stu_vaccconc <- sapply(unique(stu_included_perpat$pat), function(x) {
  # Define pathogen file
  pat_file <- case_when(x %in% c("dipht", "tetan", "pertu") ~ "dtp",
                        x %in% c("measl", "mumps", "rubel") ~ "mmr",
                        TRUE ~ x)
  # Define pathogen vaccine concentration column 
  pat_vacconc <- case_when(x == "men" ~ "vac_conc_menc",
                           x == "polio" ~ "vac_conc_polio1",
                           x == "strep" ~ "vac_conc_strep6b", 
                           TRUE ~ paste0("vac_conc_", x))
  
  # Read vaccine concentration files 
  vac_conc_all <- read_csv(glue("{dirs$raw}/studies_perpat_{pat_file}.csv"), 
                           show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(vac_conc = !!sym(pat_vacconc)) %>%
    filter(study %in% filter(stu_included_perpat, included == TRUE, pat == x)$study) 
  
  # Define relevant columns for tidying
  vars <- c("study", "vac_conc", "vac_conc_unit", "rct_group_des", "vac_type")
  vac_conc_all <- vac_conc_all %>%
    distinct(across(all_of(vars[vars %in% names(vac_conc_all)]))) %>%
    mutate(across(-c("vac_conc"), tolower))
  
  # Vaccine concentrations for studies with unique vaccine concentration 
  vac_conc_1 <- vac_conc_all %>%
    distinct(study, vac_conc) %>%
    group_by(study) %>%
    filter(n() == 1) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  # Add vaccine concentrations to each rct group and country
  stu_vaccconc <- stu_rctg[[x]] %>%
    # First add unique vaccine concentrations
    left_join(vac_conc_1, by = join_by(study)) %>%
    # Select manually the vaccine concentrations that were multiple per study
    fun_dgsk_vacconc(pat = x) %>%
    # Set 0 to NAs
    mutate(vac_conc = na_if(vac_conc, 0)) %>%
    # Add vaccine concentration units 
    left_join(distinct(vac_conc_all, study, vac_conc, vac_conc_unit), 
              by = join_by(study, vac_conc), relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
    # Exponentiation if necessary 
    mutate(vac_conc = case_when(str_detect(vac_conc_unit, "10e") ~ 10^vac_conc,
                                .default = vac_conc)) %>%
    mutate(vac_conc_unit = str_remove_all(vac_conc_unit, "_10e")) %>%
    # Fix vaccine concentrations units for dipht and tetan
    mutate(vac_conc_unit = case_when(!is.na(vac_conc) ~ "lf", .default = NA))
  
  return(stu_vaccconc)
}, simplify = FALSE)

bind_rows(stu_vaccconc)
```

# Save vaccine concentrations
```{r}
saveRDS(bind_rows(stu_vaccconc, .id = "pat"), glue("{dirs$processed}/stu_vacconc.rds"))
```
